usage: This is the standard, everyday way to ask someone where they are from in Morocco. It can be used in both casual and formal situations, as Darija does not have a strict formal 'you' pronoun. You will hear this asked of foreigners to find out their home country, or among Moroccans to ask which city they are from.

variants.label: to a woman
variants.note: Use this when addressing a single female.

variants.label: to a group
variants.note: Use this when addressing two or more people.

variants.label: emphatic to a man
variants.note: A slightly more emphatic or rhythmic variation of 'nta', common in casual speech.

variants.label: emphatic to a woman
variants.note: A slightly more emphatic variation of 'nti'.

examples.english: Where are you from in Morocco?
Excuse me sister, where are you from?
